adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Neonatal watery diarrhea with polyhydramnios, high stool chloride, low urinary chloride, hypochloremia/hypokalemia and metabolic alkalosis is congenital chloride diarrhea.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Neonatal Bartter causes renal chloride wasting and high urinary chloride; the congenital enteropathies can cause severe diarrhea but not this chloride-rich alkalotic SLC26A3 signature.
